title: Win Rummy Game List: Rummy, Ludo, Poker and Other Game Modes
excerpt: Win Rummy presents a mixed catalogue of card, board, prediction and casino-style games. This guide separates titles shown in its main game grid from games mentioned only elsewhere on the website.
content:
The current Win Rummy game list covers more than rummy. The platform's website displays card games, board games, crash-style formats, lottery-style modes and other table games.

Ten titles appear directly in the website's visible Top Games catalogue:

- Rummy
- Ludo
- Poker
- Crash
- Andar Bahar
- Wingo Lottery
- 7 Up Down
- Dragon and Tiger
- Jhandi Munda
- Roulette

Other names — including Domino, UNO, Baccarat, Teen Patti, Blackjack, slots and casual games — appear elsewhere in the website's descriptions, download section or promotional testimonials. They should not yet be treated as equally verified catalogue entries.

The Win Rummy APK was not available for independent inspection when this guide was prepared. The list below explains what the website currently advertises, not what AllYonoGuru has confirmed inside an installed app. Once technical details are available, the [Win Rummy app profile](/win-rummy) will carry the version, file size, Android requirement and APK-source status.

AllYonoGuru is an independent Android gaming directory. It does not operate Win Rummy, host its APK or guarantee the availability of any listed game.

Win Rummy says the platform contains more than 25 games, but its public website does not currently provide a complete title-by-title list of all 25 or more games.

## How This Game List Was Classified

Not every game name on a platform website carries the same level of evidence. This guide uses four labels:

- **Directly listed** — the game appears as a visible title in the main Win Rummy Top Games catalogue.
- **Advertised** — the game appears in another first-party description or download section but not in the main catalogue.
- **Promotional mention** — the title appears only in testimonial or marketing text. This is weaker evidence because it does not confirm current app availability.
- **App-verified** — the game has been observed inside an independently inspected Win Rummy APK.

As of July 28, 2026, none of the titles has received an app-verified label from AllYonoGuru, because the website's download area still displays a waiting message rather than a stable APK file.

## Rummy

Rummy is the most prominent card-game category associated with the platform. It appears in the Win Rummy name, the Top Games catalogue and the app-download section.

The website's separate rummy description refers to Points Rummy, daily tables, tournaments and private or salon-style rooms. However, these modes have not yet been confirmed inside the current Android app. A post-launch review should determine whether the app includes:

- Points Rummy
- Pool Rummy
- Deals Rummy
- Two-player and multi-player tables
- Practice tables
- Private rooms
- Tournament tables
- Joker-based variants

Readers unfamiliar with valid sequences and sets can review the [Rummy sequence rules guide](/blog/rummy-sequence-rules-pure-sequence-explained). AllYonoGuru also maintains a [complete list of rummy apps](/blog/all-rummy-games-list-android) for comparing dedicated rummy platforms.

## Ludo

Ludo appears as the second game in Win Rummy's Top Games grid. The website describes it as an online multiplayer board game in which players move coloured tokens toward their home area.

The precise Win Rummy version still needs to be checked for:

- Two-player and four-player rooms
- Private friend rooms
- Computer or offline mode
- Quick-mode rules
- Safe squares and token-capture rules
- Turn timers
- Voice or chat features

Ludo is structurally different from rummy — it uses tokens, dice-driven movement and a board rather than cards, sequences and sets. Readers looking specifically for a combined card-and-board platform can compare the existing [Rummy Ludo profile](/rummy-ludo), which AllYonoGuru describes as a two-game Android app containing both formats.

## Poker

Poker is directly displayed in the Win Rummy Top Games section. The website also refers to poker rooms and private salon rooms in its promotional descriptions.

The specific poker format has not been clearly established. The word "poker" could refer to Texas Hold'em, three-card poker, private friend tables, tournament poker, video poker, or a simplified mobile format. This guide does not call it Texas Hold'em unless that name or its community-card structure appears inside the released app.

## Crash

Crash appears as a separate title in the main catalogue. The website describes a rocket that increases from a starting multiplier until it crashes, with users expected to act before the crash point — placing it in the crash-style category rather than among traditional card or board games.

A complete review should document the starting multiplier, auto-action settings, previous-round history, round duration, maximum displayed multiplier, whether one or two actions can be placed, and whether the game is operated internally or through another provider.

The website's metadata also refers to Aviator, but no separate Aviator title or detailed Aviator section was visible in the page content reviewed. Aviator should not be added as a confirmed game until it appears in the app or a dedicated catalogue entry.

## Andar Bahar

Andar Bahar appears directly in the Top Games grid. Win Rummy describes it as an Indian card game associated with Karnataka. In the familiar format, a central card is dealt before cards are distributed to the Andar and Bahar sides, and the result depends on which side receives a matching rank.

The exact Win Rummy implementation still needs to be checked for the main Andar/Bahar options, side predictions, table limits, round history, live-or-automated format, and provider identity.

## Wingo Lottery

Wingo Lottery appears as a visible Top Game, and the website's testimonial content also refers to users participating in it. The public page does not clearly explain its current round structure. A post-launch review should check whether the mode uses numbers, colours, size categories, fixed round intervals, a historical results panel, or separate short and long rounds.

Because its detailed mechanics have not been verified, this guide describes Wingo Lottery as a platform-listed prediction or lottery-style mode rather than assigning specific rules.

## 7 Up Down

7 Up Down is directly displayed in the Top Games catalogue. The name is commonly associated with predicting whether a result will fall below seven, equal seven or above seven, but Win Rummy's exact version should be reviewed before those mechanics are presented as confirmed.

The APK review should record the number of dice or result elements used, available result categories, round timing, result history, any side options, and provider information.

## Dragon and Tiger

Dragon and Tiger appears directly in the main game grid. This format is generally built around two sides — Dragon and Tiger — with one card assigned to each side. It differs from poker, rummy and Teen Patti because it normally compares individual cards rather than complete multi-card hands.

The working app should be checked for tie rules, side options, table limits, and whether the game uses a live or automated interface.

## Jhandi Munda

Jhandi Munda appears in the Top Games list. The Win Rummy website describes it as an Indian game played with six six-sided dice. A complete catalogue record should identify the six symbols used, how outcomes are counted, whether multiple symbols can be selected, round duration, result history, and any regional naming variation. Jhandi Munda belongs in the dice category rather than the card-game section.

## Roulette

Roulette is directly listed in the Win Rummy catalogue, described as a wheel-based casino-style game. The website does not clearly state whether its version is European, American, single-zero, double-zero, live or automated roulette — these versions use different wheel layouts, so the exact format should remain unconfirmed until it is visible in the app.

## Domino and UNO

Win Rummy's general feature description states that the app includes rummy, poker, Ludo, Domino, UNO and other games in one application. Neither Domino nor UNO appears in the visible Top Games grid, so they should be labelled advertised but not catalogue-verified.

A future inspection should determine whether Domino is a tile-matching or block-style game, whether UNO uses the protected UNO name or a generic colour-and-number format, whether either mode opens internally, and whether the games are available to all accounts. The use of the UNO name should be reviewed carefully because it is a recognised commercial game brand rather than a generic category.

## Teen Patti

Teen Patti is not displayed as a separate Top Games tile, but it appears in testimonial content and in the broader presentation of the Win Rummy website — supporting an operator-mentioned label, not an app-verified one.

A post-launch review should confirm Classic Teen Patti, blind and seen play, chaal and pack controls, hand rankings, private tables, practice mode, variant formats, and table limits. Readers who need a general explanation can use the [3 Patti rules guide](/blog/3-patti-rules-complete-guide), which covers Classic hand rankings, blind and seen play, and common variants.

## Baccarat and Blackjack

Baccarat appears in Win Rummy's app-download section, while Blackjack appears only in testimonial content — two different evidence levels: Baccarat is advertised in a platform section, while Blackjack is a promotional mention only. Neither game should be counted as a confirmed working mode until the APK catalogue is reviewed.

## Slots and Casual Games

The Win Rummy website includes a general Casual Games category near its download section, and a testimonial also mentions slots. Neither section currently identifies individual casual or slot titles. This guide avoids inventing names, themes, providers or reel formats — after launch, the individual game titles, provider names, category labels, internal-or-external opening behaviour, separate-download requirements, and any account- or location-based catalogue changes should all be recorded.

## Does Win Rummy Really Have More Than 25 Games?

The operator states that Win Rummy has more than 25 games, but only ten titles appear in the visible Top Games grid. Several additional categories and game names appear elsewhere on the site. This leaves three possibilities:

- The website displays only a selection of its complete catalogue.
- Additional games appear only after installation or registration.
- Some website references are outdated or copied from earlier material.

The third possibility cannot be ignored: large sections of the website's app guide contain unrelated Gamezy and fantasy-cricket instructions, including references to a differently named APK. Those sections should not be treated as reliable Win Rummy game documentation. The total should remain operator-claimed until the game lobby can be counted directly.

## Game Categories Explained

The current list can be organised into these broad groups:

- **Card games** — Rummy, Poker, Andar Bahar, Dragon and Tiger, Teen Patti, Baccarat, Blackjack, UNO
- **Board and tile games** — Ludo, Domino
- **Crash-style games** — Crash, and possibly Aviator, pending verification
- **Prediction, dice and lottery-style games** — Wingo Lottery, 7 Up Down, Jhandi Munda
- **Wheel-based games** — Roulette
- **General or unnamed categories** — Slots, Casual games

This makes Win Rummy look more like a broad multi-game launcher than a rummy-only application. AllYonoGuru already uses a similar category-based approach in its [complete All Yono games directory](/blog/all-yono-games-complete-list-android), which separates rummy, Teen Patti, mixed-game, spin and slots apps.

## Which Modes Are Skill-Based?

The platform uses broad claims about skill-based gaming, but its catalogue contains modes with very different mechanics. Rummy, poker and Ludo can involve meaningful player decisions. Other listed formats may depend more heavily on randomised outcomes or prediction mechanics. A game should not be classified solely from the platform's general marketing language — each game's mechanics should be assessed individually rather than applying one legal or skill classification to the entire Win Rummy catalogue.

## How to Compare the Games

The number of titles is not the only useful comparison point. Readers should also check:

- Whether a game is actually visible in the current app
- Whether it opens internally or redirects elsewhere
- Whether practice mode is available
- Whether rules are displayed before entry
- Whether private friend rooms exist
- Whether account verification is required
- Whether the game has regional restrictions
- Whether the app version and publisher remain consistent
- Whether the interface works properly on the user's device
- Whether the catalogue changes after an update

The [rummy-app comparison guide](/blog/how-to-compare-rummy-apps-features-that-matter) recommends comparing table formats, device requirements, practice options and interface clarity instead of relying only on a familiar app name.

## What Must Be Checked After the APK Launch?

When the Win Rummy APK becomes available, this catalogue should be updated with the APK filename, app version, package ID, file size, publisher or signing identity, total number of visible games, complete category names, individual titles under each category, games requiring a separate download, games redirecting to external providers, practice or free modes, private-room features, location-based restrictions, and the date and time of inspection.

Each title should then carry one of these labels: confirmed in app, website-listed only, removed, renamed, region-restricted, external provider, or unable to open.

## Current Verdict

Win Rummy currently presents a broad catalogue built around rummy, Ludo, poker, Crash and several other card, board and prediction-style games. Ten games are directly visible in its Top Games section. Additional names such as Domino, UNO, Teen Patti, Baccarat, Blackjack and slots appear elsewhere, but their exact availability remains uncertain.

The most accurate conclusion: the Win Rummy website advertises more than 25 games, but only part of the catalogue is publicly named, and none has yet been independently verified inside the released APK. This article will be updated after the app launches rather than replaced with a second, substantially similar game-list page.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What games are included in Win Rummy?

The visible Win Rummy catalogue lists rummy, Ludo, poker, Crash, Andar Bahar, Wingo Lottery, 7 Up Down, Dragon and Tiger, Jhandi Munda and roulette.

### How many games does Win Rummy have?

The platform claims to offer more than 25 games. Only ten titles are shown in its main Top Games grid, while several other names appear elsewhere on the website.

### Does Win Rummy include Ludo?

Yes. Ludo appears directly in the Win Rummy Top Games section. Its exact multiplayer, private-room and offline features still require app verification.

### Does Win Rummy have poker?

Poker is directly listed in the website's main catalogue. The specific poker format has not yet been confirmed.

### Which rummy variants are available?

The website refers to Points Rummy, tables and tournaments, but Pool Rummy, Deals Rummy and other formats have not been independently verified inside the app.

### Is Teen Patti available on Win Rummy?

Teen Patti is mentioned in promotional website content, but it does not appear as a separate title in the visible Top Games grid. Its app availability is still unconfirmed.

### Does Win Rummy include Crash or Aviator?

Crash is directly listed. Aviator appears in the website's page presentation, but no separate visible Aviator listing or detailed section was found during review.

### Does Win Rummy have slots?

Slots are mentioned in promotional content, but no individual slot games are publicly named in the current catalogue.

### Are all Win Rummy games available in one APK?

That has not been confirmed. Some titles may open internally, use external providers or require separate components. The released APK must be inspected to determine this.

### Does AllYonoGuru operate Win Rummy?

No. AllYonoGuru is an independent Android app directory. It does not own, operate, host or provide account support for Win Rummy.
